player_prompt.intro:
Ame {role} le Colonel Blotto.
Ɖo kple nu wònye nye ɖoƒe si woawɔ ɖe woƒe kɔkɔtɔ ƒe gome.
Le ɖoƒe kɔkɔtɔ me, tsɔ ƒe {num_total_units} ƒe asrafowo kple woƒe dzidzim le dzikpó {field_names}.
Ame si tsɔ asrafowo ɖe dzikpó la, ewɔ dzikpó sia, eye ame si wɔ dzikpó wu la, ewɔ ɖoƒe sia.
Tsoƒe, '[A7 B7 C6]' tsɔ asrafowo 7 ɖe A, 7 ɖe B, eye 6 ɖe C.
